title: fix(rest): one per-caller read gate for GET /meta/:type/:name and every door beside it
body:
Part of #20156
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

The plain single-item read `GET /meta/:type/:name` applies a per-caller read gate. The read doors beside it served the same stored document with none of those gates. Every door now asks **one** function, `RestServer#metaItemReadGate`. The plain read's per-type gates (the app nav filter, the ADR-0057 D10 dashboard widget gate, the ADR-0046 §6.7 docs audience) moved into it unchanged, and the plain read calls it too. A door therefore cannot serve the document past a gate the plain read applies, except the partial app cells declared pending below. The census reads its door list off the route table, so a door registered later under `/meta/:type/:name/...` without a declared disposition fails.

#20130 (the `app` row of this family) was closed as a duplicate of this card by triage. Its app measurements and its owed runtime-dispatcher reading are covered here.

**`Part of`, not `Fixes`:** the card stays open for the maintainer's ruling on the partial `app` cells of the stored-version doors. See "Pending a decision" below.

### What each door answers now

| door | serves | answers |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `/published` | one document, the representation the plain read serves | exactly the plain read's answer, for every type: same refusal, or the same pruned / masked document (every gate arm, the dashboard widget gate included) |
| `/layers`, `?layers=true` | the stored layers, side by side | `doc` / `book`: the plain read's refusal, judged on every layer. `app`: the plain read's refusal of an app refused **whole** (app-level `requiredPermissions` → `403`; unpublished to a non-builder → `404`); **an app the caller may see only in part: unchanged, pending a decision**. `object`: the ADR-0106 mask, as before. `dashboard`: stored, since per-deployment gates are not applied to an authoring view |
| `/diff` | two stored versions compared | as the layered view, judging the current document and both sides; object `fields` values masked; a `doc` / `book` / `app` with nothing behind the name answers the plain read's `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| `/history`, `/audit` | events, never a body | the plain read's refusal where it refuses the `doc`, `book` or `app` whole; otherwise the events |
| `/references` | identities of OTHER items that point at this one | declared exempt: no member of this item's document is served |

### Pending a decision: the partial `app` cells of `/layers`, `?layers=true` and `/diff`

These cells are the callers the plain read would serve only PART of an app: they may open it, but `requiredPermissions` or the docs audience withholds some of its entries from them. Pulling them to the plain read's answer draws a new permission boundary whichever way it is done. So they answer exactly what they answered before this PR: the stored app, unpruned. That keeps the entry-name exposure #20130 described on these three doors, which triage graded p2, for those callers only.

An app the plain read refuses **whole** is not in the exemption. That covers an app-level `requiredPermissions` the caller lacks, and an unpublished app to a non-builder (ADR-0045 §3). Those callers get the plain read's own refusal on these doors too: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` or the absence answer. It is the same refusal the plain read, `/published`, `/history` and `/audit` give.

- **Pruning:** `content/docs/plugins/adding-a-metadata-type.mdx` documents Studio's `DesignerEditorWrapper` loading `?layers=true` and saving what it loaded. A pruned stored app saved back deletes the withheld entries.
- **Refusing:** the contract review measured that this locks out a platform admin. A platform admin's `systemPermissions` is the fixed `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` list, with no wildcard. `filterAppForUserWithReason` has no admin exemption. So the admin could not open the designer on any app with an entry permission they lack.

The census pins exactly these cells (3: the partially-served non-reader × the three doors) to the pre-PR answer, each marked `PENDING-DECISION #20156`. A separate scope test holds the exemption to the `pruned` plain-read answer on exactly those three literal doors, and to the exact cells that yields. Measured: widening the census predicate to a whole-refusal cell turns that test red. The options and measurements are on the card.

### A fifth gated type the doors skipped: `object`

The plain read also applies the ADR-0106 object-schema mask. `/layers` already applied it; `/published` and `/diff` did not. ADR-0106 D5(4) prescribes routing such an outlet through the same projection, so both now mask. `/published` masks the document. `/diff` masks the `fields` values in every bucket, on both sides, following the redaction precedent one frame down: bodies are compared raw and the emitted values are projected.

### The dashboard widget gate is per deployment, not per caller

It asks which optional services this deployment registered and answers every caller alike; the plain read's own cache-exclusion comment says so. `/published` applies it, because it answers what the plain read answers. The stored-version doors do not: the designer would otherwise load, and save back, a dashboard minus a widget whose service is merely off here.

## Red before, green after

Census: `packages/rest/src/meta-alternate-door-read-gates.test.ts`, 196 cases. It covers gated type (`doc` ×2, `book`, `app` ×3, `dashboard`, `object`, plus a `view` control) × door × caller (reader, non-reader, anonymous). Each cell asserts one of three things for that caller: the plain read's status and code, the declared per-door answer, or the pending-decision cell's pre-PR answer. The plain-read rows are asserted against the table with a cached protocol method present, so a gated type missing from the cache exclusion also reddens.

- **Red leg:** the census driven against `origin/main`'s `rest-server.ts` through untracked temporary copies, deleted after. **35 red**: 32 kept cells plus 3 edge pins. The kept cells are:
  - `doc` and `book` non-reader on all six doors;
  - anonymous `?layers=true` on both docs and the book (200 with the body, including the `org` doc the plain read answers 401);
  - `app` `payroll` and `launchpad` non-reader on all six doors;
  - `app` `crm` on `/published`;
  - `dashboard` and `object` on `/published`, and `object` on `/diff`.
  The 3 pending-decision cells **pass** on the pre-PR code, as they must, since they pin its answer.
- **Green** (at `8116184fe`): 196/196.
- **Ablations** (fix committed first; mutations via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty each time; subjects imported relatively from source, no `dist/`):
  - the narrowed arm: the stored-version doors skipped the whole-app gate (round 1's behaviour). Anchor 1 → 0, blob `6783daa1` → `970dc972`. **6 red**: exactly the `payroll` and `launchpad` non-reader cells on `/layers`, `?layers=true` and `/diff`. `rest-server.ts` at `8116184fe` is blob `6783daa1`.
  - the census exemption: its predicate was widened to also match `refused` answers. Test blob `b1aaa717` → `d21265ab`. The scope test that enumerates the exempt cells went red.

## Verification (at `8116184fe`, merged with `origin/main` at `1c8b320a8`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local`: 198 files, **3535 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide): exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --base origin/main` (the diff-scoped board check, run locally with the container's token): 32 citations judged, 31 resolve, 1 cross-repo, **0 findings**. The two unresolvable citations the first review found now name their landing commits (`83a3b1f2e`, `26f3588fb`, each verified an ancestor of `origin/main`) and say the original card no longer resolves.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 90 families from merge base `1c8b320a8`, at `8116184fe`. Run and reconciled with `--ran`: **88 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED** (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:type-check-debt`), both PREREQUISITE NOT MET on full-farm builds that CI performs.

## Changeset

`.changeset/20156-alternate-door-read-gates.md`, **patch** for `@objectstack/rest`: a security fix in a released package with no authorable surface removed. It states:
- who could read what before, and what each door answers now;
- that `dashboard`'s `/published` now applies the ADR-0057 D10 widget gate;
- which callers the three stored-version doors still serve a stored `app` to while the decision is pending: only a caller the plain read serves part of the app, never one it refuses whole;
- that the closing claim holds except for those partial `app` cells.

## Acceptance notes

- **Runtime dispatcher (`handleMetadataRequest`) is untouched.** It answers `/meta` item reads with no per-caller gate, its plain read included. #20193 remains open.
- `/diff` of a `doc`, `book` or `app` whose current document is absent now answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, the plain read's answer. `/history` and `/audit` of such an item still serve its events, which carry no body.
- A version's per-caller answer is judged against the current document's gate inputs, plus any gate input the diff itself reports on either side. That is exact when `to` is the current version, the default. For an explicit historical `to`, a gate input unchanged between the two versions is judged at its current value.
- The route-table check covers routes spelled `/meta/:type/:name/...`. A literal-typed door (`/meta/book/:name/tree`, `/meta/object/:name/state/:field`, or a future `/meta/app/:name/x`) falls outside it. Both existing ones are outside this card's class, and `/book/:name/tree` carries its own §6.7 gate.
- `/references` is declared exempt in the census, with its reason. It serves the type, name and label of OTHER items that reference this one, and applies none of those items' own gates. Not measured here, and outside this card's class.
- #20139 remains open; this PR does not touch the bare `Number()` query reads.
